ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.20; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in mottled patches on the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes; diffuse light-grey mottled blobs concentrated in the medial-lower quadrant of the left lobe; predominant low-intensity black field across the remainder of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped intersection visible at the waterline; approximate pixel angle of 72 degrees with a moderate-depth depression.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serration; left lobe trailing edge features 6 distinct high-amplitude peaks; right lobe features 5 distinct peaks; all peaks show sharp pixel transitions against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, sweeping outward and upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel linear light-grey pixel streaks; 4-5 prominent vertical marks on the left lobe and 2-3 diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme serration and irregular chipping along the entire visible trailing edge; dense white circular scarring at the distal tips corresponding to prior colonization.
